content.title: ORGANS YOU DIDN'T EVEN KNOW YOU COULD FEED WITH {{BREAKFAST}}
facts: **Fennel** is good for DIGESTION — it relaxes gut muscles and eases trapped gas within a half hour of eating it raw or as tea.
**Pomegranate** is good for ARTERIES — its polyphenols help keep artery walls flexible, which keeps blood flowing smoothly.
**Clams** are good for IRON STORES — just 3 oz covers your entire day's iron needs, more than a serving of red meat.
**Asparagus** is good for KIDNEYS — it acts as a natural diuretic, helping flush excess fluid and sodium out of your system.
**Brazil Nuts** are good for THYROID — 1-2 nuts a day supply enough selenium to support healthy hormone production.
**Cabbage** is good for STOMACH LINING — its glutamine content helps soothe and rebuild irritated gut tissue.
**Mussels** are good for NERVE FUNCTION — they're loaded with vitamin B12, which keeps nerve signals firing properly.
**Celery** is good for BLOOD PRESSURE — compounds called phthalides help relax the walls of your blood vessels.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Fennel does more than freshen your breath — the natural compounds in it relax the smooth muscle lining your intestines, which is exactly why it's been used for centuries to quiet down bloating after a heavy meal. Pomegranate works differently: the polyphenols it's packed with reduce oxidative stress on your artery walls, helping them stay flexible instead of stiff, which matters more for long-term circulation than most people realize. And clams are an underrated iron source — unlike iron from plants, the iron in clams is heme iron, which your body absorbs far more easily, making it one of the most efficient ways to top up your stores. Everyone's body is different, listen to yours.
